Definition: to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint; by implication, to consecrate; also to paint
BiblicalUsage: 1) to smear, anoint, spread a liquid; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to smear; 1a2) to anoint (as consecration); 1a3) to anoint, consecrate; 1b) (Niphal) to be anointed
